paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得过去两周一次白天主要休息，终于有机会躺下，却不清楚何时从有睡意变得清醒；另一段记忆还涉及周围声音。机会、感觉与未知可以分别保留，不归因为想太多或努力不足。例子不要求看钟、追踪思绪、再试入睡或证明环境已经足够好。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a daytime main rest during the past two weeks, with an opportunity to lie down but an unclear transition from sleepiness to alertness. Another recollection involves surrounding sounds. Opportunity, experience and unknowns stay separate without an overthinking or poor-effort explanation. The scene requires no clock check, thought tracking, repeated sleep attempt or proof of an adequate environment.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得有机会休息时仍醒着；过程和原因不清；想先问哪些情况值得说明。”可以只读虚构卡，不交作息表。听者不规定多久应该睡着，不保证只是担忧，也不要求先改变睡眠安排；已有治疗与合适评估不等待记录完整。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names remembered wakefulness despite a rest opportunity, leaves the process and cause unclear and asks which circumstances are useful to explain. Read only the fictional card without a timetable. A listener sets no expected time to fall asleep, offers no explanation of only worry and requires no changed sleep arrangement. Existing treatment and appropriate assessment need no complete record.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是ISI、睡眠日记、诊断、睡眠限制或认知治疗。20条仍保留五组各四条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算夜晚、醒来次数、分钟或小时，未计分不补零。五个可重叠的主题是阅读分组，不建立原因、睡眠是否足够、警醒或安全结论。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；两周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长或求助等待期，主要睡眠可在任何时段。任何组合不授权改变药物、助眠品或已有治疗，不替代合适评估和原有安全说明。五篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、时间、设备或健康资料。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not ISI, a sleep diary, diagnosis, sleep restriction or cognitive treatment. Twenty descriptions retain five six-category records of four. Counts concern descriptions, not nights, awakenings, minutes or hours; unscored is not zero. Five overlapping topics organise reading and establish no cause, sufficient sleep, alertness or safety conclusion. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; two weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration or waiting period for support. Main sleep can occur at any time. No pattern authorises changes to medicines, sleeping products or existing treatment, or replaces appropriate assessment and the existing safety information. All five guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, times, device records or health information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得主要休息中被一项事务打断，另一次只记得醒着，没有清楚的外部事件。两段可在同一类别里保留不同背景，不证明相同原因或需要同一方法。例子不要求数醒来次数、让同住者观察、核对设备或下一次醒来时监测；未记得时长不补成零。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a practical interruption during main rest and, on another occasion, only wakefulness without a clear external event. One category can retain different circumstances without a shared cause or method. The scene requires no counted awakenings, household observer, device comparison or monitoring at the next waking. An unremembered duration does not become zero.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“记得的一段清醒”“知道的背景”和“仍未知的事”，可以全谈虚构例子，不重建每次醒来。听者不把中断当照护者失误，不要求证明能消除中断，也不从计数小推出休息良好；可以先了解专业谈话会问什么，而不先接受一个原因。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a remembered stretch of wakefulness, known context and unknowns, using only a fictional example without reconstructing every waking. A listener blames no caregiver, requires no proof that an interruption can be removed and infers no good rest from a small count. Discussion can begin with what a professional conversation may ask without first accepting a cause.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得轮班变化后自己打算的休息结束时间也变了；另一次则想继续休息却已经醒着。即使钟点相同，两段也不是同一种叙述。例子不要求提供时间戳、重建分钟或比较谁起得健康，不决定应该起身、留床或改变光照安排。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls an intended rest ending changing with a shift schedule and, on another occasion, wakefulness while wanting further rest. Even at one clock time these are different accounts. The scene requires no timestamp, reconstructed minutes or comparison of healthy rising times and decides no getting up, staying in bed or changed light schedule.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“更早是相对我原本的计划，不是一个统一钟点；有些安排想保留；想问怎样说明这项经历。”可以只读。听者不把早起当自律或失败，不要求提供睡眠时长证明，也不替人规定下一次作息；这段描述不作药物或治疗决定。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card defines earlier relative to an intended plan rather than one universal hour, keeps some arrangements private and asks how to describe the experience. Reading alone is enough. A listener treats no early start as discipline or failure, requires no duration evidence and prescribes no next schedule. The description makes no medicine or treatment decision.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一项普通事务很费力，却不记得是否困到难睁眼；另一段记忆涉及注意被拉开，任务要求不清。疲倦、困倦和注意可以分别保留，不能拼成警醒或工作能力结论。例子不安排耐力、注意测试或硬撑活动；现有安全说明不等待计数或这段例子提供放行。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls an effortful ordinary task without knowing whether sleepiness made keeping their eyes open difficult; another recollection involves attention moving away with task demands unclear. Tiredness, sleepiness and attention remain separate without an alertness or work-capacity verdict. The scene assigns no endurance test, attention test or pushing through an activity. Existing safety guidance needs no count, and this example provides no clearance.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得这项普通事今天更费力；原因不清；想只谈眼前需要，不分享睡眠细节。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不以产出评价值，不要求先证明睡眠导致困难，也不把少量记录当作继续安全任务的依据。是否可用某种安排由实际场景决定，卡片不保证回应。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names an effortful ordinary task with an unknown cause and focuses on a present need without sleep details. Read only the fictional card. A listener rates no worth by output, requires no proof that sleep caused difficulty and uses no sparse record to justify continuing a safety-sensitive task. Available arrangements remain specific to the setting; the card promises no response.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得在意下一段活动，也曾因醒着而看时间，却不清楚两件事的先后；另一次只记得沮丧。想法、动作与未知可以分别描述，不证明态度造成睡眠困难，也不要求找到某个想法才算完整。例子不安排移走时钟、压制想法、强迫放松或排练次日会顺利。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls concern about a later activity and checking time while awake without knowing the sequence; another occasion is remembered only as frustration. Thought, action and unknowns stay separate without an attitude-based cause of sleep difficulty or a required thought to complete the account. The scene assigns no removed clock, thought suppression, forced relaxation or rehearsal of a successful next day.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈睡眠周围的担心，不先决定身体或心理解释；部分想法想保留；现在只想了解怎样开始。”可以只读。听者不说只要别想就好，不保证下一次能睡着，也不重复提供确定性问答。支持不要求停止担心或达到计数，已有专业意见保持独立。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names concern around sleep without first choosing a physical or psychological explanation, keeps some thoughts private and asks how to begin. Read without a personal account. A listener offers no just-stop-thinking response, promises no sleep at the next opportunity and repeats no certainty-providing exchange. Support requires neither stopped worry nor a count; existing professional advice remains independent.
